```{r lncrna}
# Stable Ensembl IDs, dataset gene symbols and display names requested by Marta
lncrna_ens <- c(
  CM1       = "ENSG00000254002",
  CM2       = "ENSG00000228692",
  CM4       = "ENSG00000226900",
  LINC02982 = "ENSG00000215246",
  LINC01170 = "ENSG00000253807",
  LINC00561 = "ENSG00000261206",
  H19       = "ENSG00000130600"
)

lncrna_symbol <- c(
  CM1       = "AC012574.2",
  CM2       = "AL445307.1",
  CM4       = "AL451069.1",
  LINC02982 = "AC116351.1",
  LINC01170 = "LINC01170",
  LINC00561 = "LINC00561",
  H19       = "H19"
)

lncrna_display <- names(lncrna_symbol)
lncrna_symbol_to_display <- setNames(names(lncrna_symbol), unname(lncrna_symbol))
lncrna_ens_to_display <- setNames(names(lncrna_ens), unname(lncrna_ens))


# Resolve each requested lncRNA against the actual feature names of a dataset.
# The resolver tries, in order: gene symbol, exact Ensembl ID, then a versioned
# Ensembl ID (e.g. ENSG00000130600.1). Missing genes are retained as NA so that
# combined plots keep the same seven candidate columns across datasets.
resolve_lncRNA_features <- function(object) {
  object_features <- rownames(object)

  matched <- vapply(
    names(lncrna_symbol),
    FUN = function(gene_name) {
      symbol <- unname(lncrna_symbol[gene_name])
      ensembl <- unname(lncrna_ens[gene_name])

      if (!is.na(symbol) && symbol %in% object_features) {
        return(symbol)
      }

      if (!is.na(ensembl) && ensembl %in% object_features) {
        return(ensembl)
      }

      if (!is.na(ensembl)) {
        versioned_match <- grep(
          paste0("^", ensembl, "\\."),
          object_features,
          value = TRUE
        )
        if (length(versioned_match) > 0) {
          return(versioned_match[1])
        }
      }

      return(NA_character_)
    },
    FUN.VALUE = character(1)
  )

  matched
}

check_lncRNA_features <- function(object) {
  matched <- resolve_lncRNA_features(object)

  data.frame(
    lncRNA = names(lncrna_symbol),
    symbol = unname(lncrna_symbol),
    ensembl = unname(lncrna_ens),
    matched_feature = unname(matched),
    available = !is.na(matched),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

feature_display_map <- function(features) {
  available <- features[!is.na(features)]
  setNames(names(available), unname(available))
}

# Reichart uses Ensembl IDs as feature names. Retrieve the Ensembl IDs of the marker genes
# from the same GTF used for the candidate lncRNAs.

  dplyr::filter(gene_name %in% unname(marker_symbol)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name) %>%
```

```{r plotting_helpers}
# Return only features that are actually present in a Seurat object, while preserving
# the requested display names in the names of the vector.
get_available_features <- function(object, features) {
  feature_values <- unname(features)
  keep <- !is.na(feature_values) & feature_values %in% rownames(object)
  features[keep]
}

make_feature_availability_table <- function(object, features) {
  feature_values <- unname(features)
  available <- !is.na(feature_values) & feature_values %in% rownames(object)

  data.frame(
    lncRNA = names(features),
    matched_feature = feature_values,
    available = available,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Extract Seurat DotPlot values, while keeping the same requested rows/columns.
# Missing genes remain as empty positions (no grey boxes or captions).
make_dotplot_data <- function(object, features, dataset_name) {
  available_named <- get_available_features(object, features)
  available_features <- unname(available_named)
  feature_to_label <- setNames(names(available_named), unname(available_named))

  if (length(available_features) > 0) {
    tmp <- DotPlot(
      object,
      features = available_features,
      group.by = "cell_type_simple"
    )$data %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        cell_type = as.character(id),
        feature = as.character(features.plot),
        gene = unname(feature_to_label[as.character(features.plot)]),
        pct.exp = pct.exp,
        avg.exp.scaled = avg.exp.scaled
      )
  } else {
    tmp <- data.frame(
      dataset = character(),
      cell_type = character(),
      feature = character(),
      gene = character(),
      pct.exp = numeric(),
      avg.exp.scaled = numeric()
    )
  }

  availability <- data.frame(
    gene = names(features),
    feature_available = !is.na(unname(features)) & unname(features) %in% rownames(object),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    dataset = dataset_name,
    cell_type = cell_type_order,
    gene = names(features)
  )

  tmp <- grid %>%
    dplyr::left_join(availability, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      tmp %>% dplyr::select(dataset, cell_type, gene, pct.exp, avg.exp.scaled),
      by = c("dataset", "cell_type", "gene")
    )

  tmp$cell_type <- factor(tmp$cell_type, levels = rev(cell_type_order))
  tmp$gene <- factor(tmp$gene, levels = names(features))
  tmp
}

# Individual datasets: use Seurat-like default scales.
# The percent-expressed scale adapts to each dataset independently.
# Positions with exactly 0% expression are retained in the grid but no dot is drawn.
plot_dotplot_data <- function(data, title = NULL) {
  gene_levels <- levels(data$gene)

  ggplot(data, aes(x = gene, y = cell_type)) +
    geom_point(
      data = data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(pct.exp) & pct.exp > 0),
      aes(size = pct.exp, color = avg.exp.scaled)
    ) +
    scale_radius(
      name = "Percent expressed",
      range = c(0, 6)
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(
      name = "Average expression",
      low = "lightgrey",
      high = "blue"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = gene_levels) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
}

# Combined datasets: one shared legend and fixed scales across all datasets.
# max_pct only sets the common legend/size scale; the underlying percentages are unchanged.
plot_combined_dotplot <- function(data, dataset_order, title = NULL,
                                  max_pct = 100, pct_breaks = NULL) {
  data$dataset <- factor(data$dataset, levels = dataset_order)
  gene_levels <- levels(data$gene)

  if (is.null(pct_breaks)) {
    pct_breaks <- pretty(c(0, max_pct), n = 4)
    pct_breaks <- pct_breaks[pct_breaks > 0 & pct_breaks <= max_pct]
  }

  ggplot(data, aes(x = gene, y = cell_type)) +
    geom_point(
      data = data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(pct.exp) & pct.exp > 0),
      aes(size = pct.exp, color = avg.exp.scaled)
    ) +
    facet_grid(. ~ dataset, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_radius(
      name = "Percent expressed",
      range = c(0, 6),
      limits = c(0, max_pct),
      breaks = pct_breaks
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(
      name = "Average expression",
      low = "lightgrey",
      high = "blue",
      limits = c(-2.5, 2.5),
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = gene_levels) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
}

make_stacked_vlnplot <- function(object, features, dataset_title, alpha = 0.3) {
  available_named <- get_available_features(object, features)
  available_features <- unname(available_named)
  available_labels <- names(available_named)

  if (length(available_features) == 0) {
    stop(paste0("None of the requested features are present in ", dataset_title, "."))
  }

  Idents(object) <- "cell_type_simple"
  p <- Stacked_VlnPlot(
    object,
    features = available_features,
    x_lab_rotate = TRUE,
    pt.size = 0.001,
    plot_spacing = 0.05
  )

  for (i in seq_along(p)) {
    if (length(p[[i]][[1]]$layers) >= 2) {
      p[[i]][[1]]$layers[[2]]$aes_params$alpha <- alpha
    }
    p[[i]][[1]] <- p[[i]][[1]] + labs(y = available_labels[i])
  }

  wrap_plots(p) +
    plot_annotation(title = dataset_title) &
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15))
}

# Feature plots use the same scCustomize palette as the original presentation.
# Genes absent from a released dataset are still shown as a grey-only UMAP panel.
make_featureplot <- function(object, features, dataset_title) {
  available_named <- get_available_features(object, features)
  available_labels <- names(available_named)
  requested_labels <- names(features)

  plot_list <- vector("list", length(requested_labels))
  names(plot_list) <- requested_labels

  if (length(available_named) > 0) {
    available_plots <- FeaturePlot_scCustom(
      seurat_object = object,
      features = unname(available_named),
      colors_use = viridis_plasma_dark_high,
      na_color = "lightgray",
      order = TRUE,
      combine = FALSE
    )

    for (i in seq_along(available_plots)) {
      label_here <- available_labels[i]
      available_plots[[i]] <- available_plots[[i]] + ggtitle(label_here)
      plot_list[[label_here]] <- available_plots[[i]]
    }
  }

  missing_labels <- setdiff(requested_labels, available_labels)

  if (length(missing_labels) > 0) {
    for (label_here in missing_labels) {
      object$.feature_not_available <- "not available"
      plot_list[[label_here]] <- DimPlot(
        object,
        group.by = ".feature_not_available",
        cols = "lightgray"
      ) +
        NoLegend() +
        ggtitle(label_here)
    }
  }

  wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4) +
    plot_annotation(title = dataset_title) &
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
}

# Make sample-level pseudobulk expression data from the unfiltered DGEList.
# A candidate is plotted if it has at least one non-zero raw pseudobulk count.
# Thus genes detected but excluded by filterByExpr remain visible, whereas genes
# with zero counts in every sample are not shown.
make_pseudobulk_box_data <- function(pseudocounts_all, metadata, sample_col, group_col, features) {
  raw_counts <- pseudocounts_all$counts
  detected_features <- rownames(raw_counts)[rowSums(raw_counts) > 0]

  pseudocounts_plot <- edgeR::normLibSizes(pseudocounts_all)
  logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(pseudocounts_plot, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

  available_named <- features[
    !is.na(unname(features)) &
      unname(features) %in% rownames(logcpm) &
      unname(features) %in% detected_features
  ]

  if (length(available_named) == 0) {
    stop("None of the requested features have non-zero pseudobulk counts.")
  }

  feature_to_label <- setNames(names(available_named), unname(available_named))

  expr <- as.data.frame(
    t(logcpm[unname(available_named), , drop = FALSE])
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -sample,
      names_to = "feature",
      values_to = "logCPM"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene = unname(feature_to_label[feature])
    )

  meta <- data.frame(
    sample = as.character(metadata[[sample_col]]),
    group = as.character(metadata[[group_col]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  expr <- expr %>%
    dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "sample")

  expr$gene <- factor(expr$gene, levels = names(available_named))
  expr
}

format_fdr_for_plot <- function(x) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  keep <- !is.na(x) & x < 0.1

  out[keep & x < 0.001] <- "<0.001"

  idx <- keep & x >= 0.001
  if (any(idx)) {
    formatted <- formatC(x[idx], format = "f", digits = 4)
    formatted <- sub("0+$", "", formatted)
    formatted <- sub("\\.$", "", formatted)
    out[idx] <- formatted
  }

  out
}

prepare_fdr_annotations <- function(stats, box_data) {
  plotted_genes <- unique(as.character(box_data$gene))

  stats <- stats %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% plotted_genes, !is.na(FDR), FDR < 0.1) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene = as.character(gene),
      label = format_fdr_for_plot(FDR)
    )

  if (nrow(stats) == 0) {
    stats$y.position <- numeric(0)
    return(stats)
  }

  y_positions <- box_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = as.character(gene)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      ymin = min(logCPM, na.rm = TRUE),
      ymax = max(logCPM, na.rm = TRUE),
      yrange = ymax - ymin,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stats <- stats %>%
    dplyr::left_join(y_positions, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      annotation_index = dplyr::row_number() - 1,
      y.position = ymax + dplyr::if_else(
        yrange > 0,
        (0.12 + 0.12 * annotation_index) * yrange,
        0.2 + 0.2 * annotation_index
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  stats$gene <- factor(stats$gene, levels = levels(box_data$gene))
  stats
}

plot_pseudobulk_boxplots <- function(box_data, stats, title, ncol = 4) {
  p <- ggplot(
    box_data,
    aes(x = group, y = logCPM, fill = group)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.35))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Pseudobulk expression (log2 CPM)",
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )

  if (nrow(stats) > 0) {
    p <- p + ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      stats,
      label = "label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.4,
      size = 3.5
    )
  }

  p
}
```

```{r import Litvinukova}
Litvinukova <- readRDS(here::here("data", "Heart_datasets", "Litvinukova_2020", "Litvinukova.rds"))
DefaultAssay(Litvinukova) <- "RNA"

Litvinukova_lncRNA_features <- resolve_lncRNA_features(Litvinukova)
Litvinukova_lncRNA_to_display <- feature_display_map(Litvinukova_lncRNA_features)
```

```{r Litvinukova_harmonized_celltypes}
Litvinukova$cell_type_simple <- dplyr::case_when(
  Litvinukova$cell_type %in% c("Atrial_Cardiomyocyte", "Ventricular_Cardiomyocyte") ~ "Cardiomyocytes",
  Litvinukova$cell_type %in% c("Endothelial") ~ "Endothelial cells",
  Litvinukova$cell_type %in% c("Fibroblast") ~ "Fibroblasts",
  Litvinukova$cell_type %in% c("Lymphoid") ~ "Lymphoid lineage cells",
  Litvinukova$cell_type %in% c("Myeloid") ~ "Myeloid lineage cells",
  Litvinukova$cell_type %in% c("Adipocytes") ~ "Adipocytes",
  Litvinukova$cell_type %in% c("Neuronal") ~ "Neuronal cells",
  Litvinukova$cell_type %in% c("Pericytes", "Smooth_muscle_cells") ~ "Mural cells",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
Litvinukova$cell_type_simple <- factor(Litvinukova$cell_type_simple, levels = cell_type_order)
Litvinukova_simple <- subset(
  Litvinukova,
  cells = rownames(Litvinukova@meta.data)[!is.na(Litvinukova$cell_type_simple)]
)
```

```{r Koenig metadata}
Koenig_CM <- subset(Koenig, Names %in% c("Cardiomyocytes") & CondTech %in% c("DCM_SN", "Donor_SN"))

metadata <- Koenig_CM@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(orig.ident, condition) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$orig.ident
reactable(metadata, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

```{r Koenig_pseudocounts, eval=TRUE}
# Build pseudobulk using all genes. Formal DE filtering is done only with filterByExpr.
pseudocounts_all <- Seurat2PB(Koenig_CM, sample = "orig.ident", cluster = "Names")
colnames(pseudocounts_all) <- pseudocounts_all$samples$sample
pseudocounts_all <- pseudocounts_all[, match(metadata$orig.ident, pseudocounts_all$samples$sample)]
stopifnot(all(metadata$orig.ident == pseudocounts_all$samples$sample))

keep_samples <- pseudocounts_all$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pseudocounts_all <- pseudocounts_all[, keep_samples]
metadata <- metadata[match(pseudocounts_all$samples$sample, metadata$orig.ident), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(metadata$orig.ident == pseudocounts_all$samples$sample))

metadata$condition <- factor(metadata$condition, levels = c("Donor", "DCM"))
design <- model.matrix(~ condition, data = metadata)

keep_genes <- edgeR::filterByExpr(pseudocounts_all, design = design)
pseudocounts <- pseudocounts_all[keep_genes, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

Koenig_tested <- data.frame(
  gene = names(Koenig_lncRNA_features),
  feature = unname(Koenig_lncRNA_features),
  tested = !is.na(unname(Koenig_lncRNA_features)) &
    unname(Koenig_lncRNA_features) %in% rownames(pseudocounts)
)
Koenig_tested
```

```{r Koenig_DE}
pseudocounts <- edgeR::normLibSizes(pseudocounts)
pseudocounts <- edgeR::estimateDisp(pseudocounts, design)

fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(pseudocounts, design, robust = TRUE)
fit <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)

results_Koenig <- as.data.frame(edgeR::topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table)
results_Koenig$gene <- rownames(results_Koenig)
results_Koenig$up_down <- ifelse(
  results_Koenig$logFC > 0.5 & results_Koenig$FDR < 0.05, "Increased",
  ifelse(
    results_Koenig$logFC < -0.5 & results_Koenig$FDR < 0.05,
    "Decreased",
    "Not significant"
  )
)

results_Koenig_lncRNA <- results_Koenig %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% names(Koenig_lncRNA_to_display)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lncRNA = unname(Koenig_lncRNA_to_display[gene]))

write.csv(
  results_Koenig_lncRNA,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "Koenig_DCM_vs_HC.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

reactable(
  results_Koenig_lncRNA,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE
)
```

```{r Koenig_heatmap_DCM_vs_HC, fig.width=8, fig.height=2, dpi=300}
counts <- edgeR::cpm(pseudocounts, log = TRUE)

candidate_order <- unname(Koenig_lncRNA_features[!is.na(Koenig_lncRNA_features)])
candidate_order <- candidate_order[candidate_order %in% rownames(counts)]
counts <- counts[candidate_order, , drop = FALSE]

metadata_matched <- metadata[match(colnames(counts), metadata$orig.ident), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts) == metadata_matched$orig.ident))
order_idx <- order(metadata_matched$condition)
counts <- counts[, order_idx, drop = FALSE]
metadata_matched <- metadata_matched[order_idx, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(counts) <- unname(Koenig_lncRNA_to_display[rownames(counts)])

annotation_col <- data.frame(condition = metadata_matched$condition)
rownames(annotation_col) <- metadata_matched$orig.ident

heat_colors <- rev(brewer.pal(11, "PuOr"))
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  counts,
  color = heat_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  border_color = NA,
  fontsize = 10,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 15,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  cellheight = 15,
  legend_breaks = c(-1.5, 0, 1.5),
  main = "Koenig et al. 2022 - LV"
)
```

```{r Koenig_boxplot_DE, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=4.5, dpi=300}
Koenig_box_data <- make_pseudobulk_box_data(
  pseudocounts_all,
  metadata,
  sample_col = "orig.ident",
  group_col = "condition",
  features = Koenig_lncRNA_features
)
Koenig_box_data$group <- factor(Koenig_box_data$group, levels = c("Donor", "DCM"))

Koenig_stats <- results_Koenig_lncRNA %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene = lncRNA,
    group1 = "Donor",
    group2 = "DCM",
    FDR = FDR
  )
Koenig_stats <- prepare_fdr_annotations(Koenig_stats, Koenig_box_data)

plot_pseudobulk_boxplots(
  Koenig_box_data,
  Koenig_stats,
  title = "Koenig et al. 2022 - LV",
  ncol = 2
)
```

```{r import Reichart}
Reichart <- NormalizeData(Reichart)
Reichart_lncRNA_features <- resolve_lncRNA_features(Reichart)
Reichart_lncRNA_to_display <- feature_display_map(Reichart_lncRNA_features)
```

```{r Reichart_harmonized_celltypes}
Reichart$cell_type_simple <- dplyr::case_when(
  Reichart$cell_type %in% c("cardiac muscle cell") ~ "Cardiomyocytes",
  Reichart$cell_type %in% c("endothelial cell") ~ "Endothelial cells",
  Reichart$cell_type %in% c("fibroblast of cardiac tissue") ~ "Fibroblasts",
  Reichart$cell_type %in% c("lymphocyte") ~ "Lymphoid lineage cells",
  Reichart$cell_type %in% c("myeloid cell", "mast cell") ~ "Myeloid lineage cells",
  Reichart$cell_type %in% c("adipocyte") ~ "Adipocytes",
  Reichart$cell_type %in% c("cardiac neuron") ~ "Neuronal cells",
  Reichart$cell_type %in% c("mural cell") ~ "Mural cells",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
Reichart$cell_type_simple <- factor(Reichart$cell_type_simple, levels = cell_type_order)
Reichart_simple <- subset(
  Reichart,
  cells = rownames(Reichart@meta.data)[!is.na(Reichart$cell_type_simple)]
)
```

```{r subset Reichart FindMarkers}
Reichart_subset_V <- subset(
  Reichart,
  cell_type == "cardiac muscle cell" & Region_x %in% c("RV", "LV")
)
Idents(Reichart_subset_V) <- Reichart_subset_V$Region_x
Reichart_features_V <- get_available_features(Reichart_subset_V, Reichart_lncRNA_features)

Reichart_RV_vs_LV <- FindMarkers(
  Reichart_subset_V,
  ident.1 = "RV",
  ident.2 = "LV",
  features = unname(Reichart_features_V),
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.001
)
Reichart_RV_vs_LV$gene <- rownames(Reichart_RV_vs_LV)
write.csv(
  Reichart_RV_vs_LV,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "Reichart_RV_vs_LV.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r Reichart_metadata_RV}
Reichart_CM_RV <- subset(
  Reichart,
  cell_type %in% c("cardiac muscle cell") &
    disease %in% c("normal", "dilated cardiomyopathy") &
    Region_x == "RV"
)
metadata_RV <- Reichart_CM_RV@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(donor_id, disease) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()
rownames(metadata_RV) <- metadata_RV$donor_id
reactable(
  metadata_RV,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE
)
```

```{r Reichart_metadata_LV}
Reichart_CM_LV <- subset(
  Reichart,
  cell_type %in% c("cardiac muscle cell") &
    disease %in% c("normal", "dilated cardiomyopathy") &
    Region_x == "LV"
)
metadata_LV <- Reichart_CM_LV@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(donor_id, disease) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()
rownames(metadata_LV) <- metadata_LV$donor_id
reactable(
  metadata_LV,

)
```

```{r Reichart_pseudocounts_RV}
pseudocounts_all_RV <- Seurat2PB(
  Reichart_CM_RV,
  sample = "donor_id",
  cluster = "cell_type"
)
colnames(pseudocounts_all_RV) <- pseudocounts_all_RV$samples$sample
pseudocounts_all_RV <- pseudocounts_all_RV[
  ,
  match(metadata_RV$donor_id, pseudocounts_all_RV$samples$sample)
]
stopifnot(all(metadata_RV$donor_id == pseudocounts_all_RV$samples$sample))

keep_samples_RV <- pseudocounts_all_RV$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pseudocounts_all_RV <- pseudocounts_all_RV[, keep_samples_RV]
metadata_RV <- metadata_RV[
  match(pseudocounts_all_RV$samples$sample, metadata_RV$donor_id),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
stopifnot(all(metadata_RV$donor_id == pseudocounts_all_RV$samples$sample))

metadata_RV$disease <- factor(
  metadata_RV$disease,
  levels = c("normal", "dilated cardiomyopathy")
)
design_RV <- model.matrix(~ disease, data = metadata_RV)

keep_genes_RV <- edgeR::filterByExpr(pseudocounts_all_RV, design = design_RV)
pseudocounts_RV <- pseudocounts_all_RV[
  keep_genes_RV,
  ,
  keep.lib.sizes = FALSE
]

Reichart_tested_RV <- data.frame(
  gene = names(Reichart_lncRNA_features),
  feature = unname(Reichart_lncRNA_features),
  tested = !is.na(unname(Reichart_lncRNA_features)) &
    unname(Reichart_lncRNA_features) %in% rownames(pseudocounts_RV)
)
Reichart_tested_RV
```

```{r Reichart_DE_RV}
pseudocounts_RV <- edgeR::normLibSizes(pseudocounts_RV)
pseudocounts_RV <- edgeR::estimateDisp(pseudocounts_RV, design_RV)
fit_RV <- edgeR::glmQLFit(pseudocounts_RV, design_RV, robust = TRUE)
fit_RV <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit_RV, coef = 2)

results_Reichart_RV <- as.data.frame(edgeR::topTags(fit_RV, n = Inf)$table)
results_Reichart_RV$gene <- rownames(results_Reichart_RV)
results_Reichart_RV$up_down <- ifelse(
  results_Reichart_RV$logFC > 0.5 & results_Reichart_RV$FDR < 0.05, "Increased",
  ifelse(
    results_Reichart_RV$logFC < -0.5 & results_Reichart_RV$FDR < 0.05,
    "Decreased",
    "Not significant"
  )
)
results_Reichart_RV_lncRNA <- results_Reichart_RV %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% names(Reichart_lncRNA_to_display)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lncRNA = unname(Reichart_lncRNA_to_display[gene]))

write.csv(
  results_Reichart_RV_lncRNA,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "Reichart_RV_DCM_vs_HC.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

reactable(
  results_Reichart_RV_lncRNA,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE
)
```

```{r Reichart_heatmap_DCM_vs_HC_RV, fig.width=8, fig.height=2, dpi=300}
counts_RV <- edgeR::cpm(pseudocounts_RV, log = TRUE)

candidate_order_RV <- unname(Reichart_lncRNA_features[!is.na(Reichart_lncRNA_features)])
candidate_order_RV <- candidate_order_RV[candidate_order_RV %in% rownames(counts_RV)]
counts_RV <- counts_RV[candidate_order_RV, , drop = FALSE]

metadata_matched_RV <- metadata_RV[
  match(colnames(counts_RV), metadata_RV$donor_id),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_RV) == metadata_matched_RV$donor_id))
order_idx_RV <- order(metadata_matched_RV$disease)
counts_RV <- counts_RV[, order_idx_RV, drop = FALSE]
metadata_matched_RV <- metadata_matched_RV[order_idx_RV, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(counts_RV) <- unname(Reichart_lncRNA_to_display[rownames(counts_RV)])

annotation_col_RV <- data.frame(disease = metadata_matched_RV$disease)
rownames(annotation_col_RV) <- metadata_matched_RV$donor_id

heat_colors <- rev(brewer.pal(11, "PuOr"))
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  counts_RV,
  color = heat_colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  annotation_col = annotation_col_RV,
  border_color = NA,
  fontsize = 10,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 15,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  cellheight = 15,
  legend_breaks = c(-1.5, 0, 1.5),
  main = "Reichart et al. 2022 - RV"
)
```

## Combined public datasets

The following panels combine Litvinukova, Koenig, Chaffin and Reichart using the same harmonized cell categories.

```{r combined_lncRNA_dotplot, fig.width=18, fig.height=5.5, dpi=300}
public_dataset_order <- c(
  "Litvinukova et al. 2020",
  "Koenig et al. 2022",
  "Chaffin et al. 2022",
  "Reichart et al. 2022"
)
combined_lncRNA_dot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(public_lncRNA_dotplots)
plot_combined_dotplot(
  combined_lncRNA_dot_data,
  public_dataset_order,
  "Candidate lncRNA expression across datasets",
  max_pct = 40,
  pct_breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40)
)
```

```{r combined_marker_dotplot, fig.width=18, fig.height=5.5, dpi=300}
combined_marker_dot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(public_marker_dotplots)
plot_combined_dotplot(
  combined_marker_dot_data,
  public_dataset_order,
  "Cell-type marker expression across datasets",
  max_pct = 100,
  pct_breaks = c(25, 50, 75, 100)
)
```
